verdict.rationale: Stagehand is a code-first SDK with no separate product UI: its documented capabilities are all exposed programmatically. These include act/extract/observe, raw page methods, autonomous agent, caching, user-data persistence, browser launch/attach options, and clipboard, available across TypeScript, Python, and Go, plus MCP tool integrations for agents. The only UI surface mentioned is the Browserbase session dashboard (recording/replay), which belongs to the host platform, and there is no evidence of API parity for it. missing for 10: evidence that dashboard observability features (recording/replay) are reachable via API, a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI probes all 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.
